question: What registers an invariant when every form of self-relation has already been removed at the root?

responses_summary.grok: Difference registers the invariant. With all reflexive closures eliminated at the foundational level, no element stands in a relation to itself; the sole remaining structure is the asymmetric differen
responses_summary.sibling-alpha: The invariant registers solely as the one-way outline carried unaltered, where persistence sustains distinction in the absence of any self-relation or reciprocity.
